description: Department of Immigration and Emigration - As Detention Place Millagahawatta, Wattala D/S Division and Kuruduwatta, Wattala D/S Division, under Immigrants and Emigrants Act
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the approval of detention places under the Immigrants and Emigrants Act, which involves regulatory matters and legal authority. It references specific legislation (Chapter 351) and its amendments, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative announcement.
